title: MonoM: Enhancing Monotonicity in Learned Cardinality Estimators
summary: Cardinality estimation is a key component of database query optimization. Recent studies have demonstrated that learned cardinality estimation techniques can surpass traditional methods in accuracy. However, a significant barrier to their adoption in production systems is their tendency to violate fundamental logical principles such as monotonicity. In this paper, we explore how learned models specifically MSCN, a query driven deep learning algorithm can breach monotonicity constraints. To address this, we propose a metric called MonoM, which quantitatively measures how well a cardinality estimator adheres to monotonicity across a given query workload. We also propose a monotonic training framework which includes a workload generator that produces directly comparable queries (one query's predicates are strictly more relaxed than another's, enabling monotonicity inference without actual execution) and a novel regularization term added to the loss function. Experimental results show that our monotonic training algorithm not only enhances monotonicity adherence but also improves cardinality estimation accuracy. This improvement is attributed to the regularization term, which reduces overfitting and improves model generalization.

title: A Study of NP-Completeness and Undecidable Word Problems in Semigroups
summary: In this paper we explore fundamental concepts in computational complexity theory and the boundaries of algorithmic decidability. We examine the relationship between complexity classes \textbf{P} and \textbf{NP}, where $L \in \textbf{P}$ implies the existence of a deterministic Turing machine solving $L$ in polynomial time $O(n^k)$. Central to our investigation is polynomial reducibility. Also, we demonstrate the existence of an associative calculus $A(\mathfrak{T})$ with an algorithmically undecidable word problem, where for a Turing machine $\mathfrak{T}$ computing a non-recursive function $E(x)$, we establish that $q_1 01^x v \equiv q_0 01^i v \Leftrightarrow x \in M_i$ for $i \in \{0,1\}$, where $M_i = \{x \mid E(x) = i\}$. This connection between computational complexity and algebraic undecidability illuminates the fundamental limits of algorithmic solutions in mathematics.

title: GPU-Virt-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Framework for Software-Based GPU Virtualization Systems
summary: The proliferation of GPU-accelerated workloads, particularly in artificial intelligence and large language model (LLM) inference, has created unprecedented demand for efficient GPU resource sharing in cloud and container environments. While NVIDIA's Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) technology provides hardware-level isolation, its availability is limited to high-end datacenter GPUs. Software-based virtualization solutions such as HAMi-core and BUD-FCSP offer alternatives for broader GPU families but lack standardized evaluation methodologies. We present GPU-Virt-Bench, a comprehensive benchmarking framework that evaluates GPU virtualization systems across 56 performance metrics organized into 10 categories. Our framework measures overhead, isolation quality, LLM-specific performance, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, PCIe throughput, multi-GPU communication, scheduling efficiency, memory fragmentation, and error recovery. GPU-Virt-Bench enables systematic comparison between software virtualization approaches and ideal MIG behavior, providing actionable insights for practitioners deploying GPU resources in multi-tenant environments. We demonstrate the framework's utility through evaluation of HAMi-core, BUD-FCSP, and simulated MIG baselines, revealing performance characteristics critical for production deployment decisions.

title: Validation methodology on real data of reversible Kalman Filter for state estimation with Manifold
summary: This work extends a previous study that introduced an algorithm for state estimation on manifolds within the framework of the Kalman filter. Its objective is to address the limitations of the earlier approach. The reversible Kalman filter was designed to provide a methodology for evaluating the accuracy of existing Kalman filter variants with arbitrary precision on synthetic data. It has favorable numerical properties on synthetic data, achieving arbitrary precision without relying on the small-velocity assumption and depending only on sensor noise. However, its application to real data encountered difficulties related to measurement noise, which was mitigated using a heuristic. In particular, the heuristic involved an event detection step switching between reversible Kalman filter and classical Kalman variant at chosen moments. In the present work, we propose a study of this detection step and propose a methodology to prove at which moment the reversible Kalman approach improves on classical multiplicative variant. In particular, we propose a metric allowing one to discriminate situations in real-world scenarios where it behaves better than classical approach.

title: Impact of Sociality Regimes on Quality of Service and Energy Efficiency in Cell-Free MIMO Networks
comments: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications Journal
summary: The cell-free architecture represents a significant advancement in network design, where each User Equipment (UE) is served by a group of distributed Access Points (APs), aimed at delivering uniformly high data rates to UEs across all locations. To ensure network scalability, user-centric clustering (UCC) has emerged as a practical approach, wherein only a selected subset of preferred APs jointly serves each UE. Forming the optimal cluster of APs for each UE is a challenging task, particularly when limited fronthaul and processing capabilities of both APs and UEs are considered. This challenge is exacerbated by the need for dynamic adjustments to enhance energy efficiency while meeting quality of service (QoS) requirements, which introduces conflicting interests between these entities. In this paper, we investigate the sociality regime of UEs and their clusters of APs, characterizing their intra-team cooperation as either selfish, egalitarian, or altruistic. These sociality regimes are crucial in achieving a balance between QoS and energy efficiency per UE. We address this problem by modeling it as a many-to-many social matching game with externalities, where connections can be established based on the sociality regime of both teams. To solve this, we introduce two novel algorithms based on Deferred Acceptance (DA) and Early Acceptance (EA) matching games. Numerical results show the significant impact of the sociality regime adopted by UEs and their clusters of APs on UE's QoS satisfaction and energy efficiency, with the egalitarian regime adopted by both entities proving the best performance trade-off.
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications Journal

title: Pruning Graphs by Adversarial Robustness Evaluation to Strengthen GNN Defenses
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a dominant paradigm for learning on graph-structured data, thanks to their ability to jointly exploit node features and relational information encoded in the graph topology. This joint modeling, however, also introduces a critical weakness: perturbations or noise in either the structure or the features can be amplified through message passing, making GNNs highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks and spurious connections. In this work, we introduce a pruning framework that leverages adversarial robustness evaluation to explicitly identify and remove fragile or detrimental components of the graph. By using robustness scores as guidance, our method selectively prunes edges that are most likely to degrade model reliability, thereby yielding cleaner and more resilient graph representations. We instantiate this framework on three representative GNN architectures and conduct extensive experiments on benchmarks. The experimental results show that our approach can significantly enhance the defense capability of GNNs in the high-perturbation regime.

title: ReCollab: Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Cooperative Ad-hoc Teammate Modeling
summary: Ad-hoc teamwork (AHT) requires agents to infer the behavior of previously unseen teammates and adapt their policy accordingly. Conventional approaches often rely on fixed probabilistic models or classifiers, which can be brittle under partial observability and limited interaction. Large language models (LLMs) offer a flexible alternative: by mapping short behavioral traces into high-level hypotheses, they can serve as world models over teammate behavior. We introduce \Collab, a language-based framework that classifies partner types using a behavior rubric derived from trajectory features, and extend it to \ReCollab, which incorporates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to stabilize inference with exemplar trajectories. In the cooperative Overcooked environment, \Collab effectively distinguishes teammate types, while \ReCollab consistently improves adaptation across layouts, achieving Pareto-optimal trade-offs between classification accuracy and episodic return. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs as behavioral world models for AHT and highlight the importance of retrieval grounding in challenging coordination settings.

title: Expert-Grounded Automatic Prompt Engineering for Extracting Lattice Constants of High-Entropy Alloys from Scientific Publications using Large Language Models
comments: 26 pages, 4 figures, Supplementary Information in the Ancillary files
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for scientific data extraction from publications, but rely on manual prompt refinement. We present an expert-grounded automatic prompt optimization framework that enhances LLM entity extraction reliability. Using high-entropy alloy lattice constant extraction as a testbed, we optimized prompts for Claude 3.5 Sonnet through feedback cycles on seven expert-annotated publications. Despite a modest optimization budget, recall improved from 0.27 to > 0.9, demonstrating that a small, expert-curated dataset can yield significant improvements. The approach was applied to extract lattice constants from 2,267 publications, yielding data for 1,861 compositions. The optimized prompt transferred effectively to newer models: Claude 4.5 Sonnet, GPT-5, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Analysis revealed three categories of LLM mistakes: contextual hallucination, semantic misinterpretation, and unit conversion errors, emphasizing the need for validation protocols. These results establish feedback-guided prompt optimization as a low-cost, transferable methodology for reliable scientific data extraction, providing a scalable pathway for complex LLM-assisted research tasks.
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, Supplementary Information in the Ancillary files

title: An Energy-Efficient RFET-Based Stochastic Computing Neural Network Accelerator
summary: Stochastic computing (SC) offers significant reductions in hardware complexity for traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs), but stochastic computing neural networks (SCNNs) still suffer from high resource usage due to components such as stochastic number generators (SNGs) and accumulative parallel counters (APCs), which limit performance. This paper introduces a novel SCNN architecture based on reconfigurable field-effect transistors (RFETs), whose device-level reconfigurability enables the design of highly efficient and compact SNGs, APCs, and other core modules. A dedicated SCNN accelerator architecture is also developed for system-level simulation. Using publicly available open-source standard cell libraries, experimental results show that the proposed RFET-based SCNN accelerator achieves substantial reductions in area, latency, and energy consumption compared to a FinFET-based design at the same technology node.

title: SoDA: An Efficient Interaction Paradigm for the Agentic Web
summary: As the internet evolves from the mobile App-dominated Attention Economy to the Intent-Interconnection of the Agentic Web era, existing interaction modes fail to address the escalating challenges of data lock-in and cognitive overload. Addressing this, we defines a future-oriented user sovereignty interaction paradigm, aiming to realize a fundamental shift from killing time to saving time. Specifically, we argue that decoupling memory from application logic eliminates the structural basis of data lock-in, while shifting from explicit manual instruction to implicit intent alignment resolves cognitive overload by offloading execution complexity. This paradigm is implemented via the Sovereign Digital Avatar (SoDA), which employs an orthogonal decoupling design of storage, computation, and interaction. This establishes the architectural principle of data as a persistent asset, model as a transient tool, fundamentally breaking the platform monopoly on user memory. To support the operation of this new paradigm in zero-trust environments, we design an Intent-Permission Handshake Mechanism based on A2A protocols, utilizing dual-factor (Sensitivity Coefficient and Strictness Parameter) adaptive routing to achieve active risk governance. Empirical evaluation with a high-fidelity simulation environment indicates that this paradigm reduces token consumption by approximately 27-35\% during cross-platform service migration and complex task execution. Furthermore, in the orchestration of multi-modal complex tasks, it reduces user cognitive load by 72\% compared to standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, by 88\% relative to manual workflows, while significantly boosting the Information Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR). These results demonstrate that the SoDA is the essential interaction infrastructure for building an efficient, low-friction, and decentralized Agentic Web.

AI.tldr: 针对智能体网络（Agentic Web）时代的数据锁定和认知超载问题，本文提出了SoDA（Sovereign Digital Avatar）范式。通过解耦内存与应用逻辑，并转向隐式意图对齐，SoDA显著降低了跨平台任务的Token消耗（27-35%）和用户认知负荷（72-88%），是去中心化智能体网络的关键基础设施。

AI.result: 在跨平台服务迁移和复杂任务执行中，Token消耗减少了约27-35%。在多模态复杂任务的编排中，用户认知负荷相比标准RAG架构减少了72%，相比手动工作流程减少了88%，同时显著提高了信息信噪比（SNR）。
AI.conclusion: SoDA是构建高效、低摩擦、去中心化智能体网络所必需的交互基础设施。

title: SlimEdge: Lightweight Distributed DNN Deployment on Constrained Hardware
summary: Deep distributed networks (DNNs) have become central to modern computer vision, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices remains hindered by substantial parameter counts and computational demands. Here, we present an approach to the efficient deployment of distributed DNNs that jointly respects hardware limitations and preserves task performance. Our method integrates a structured model pruning with a multi-objective optimization to tailor network capacity to heterogeneous device constraints. We demonstrate this framework using Multi-View Convolutional Neural Network (MVCNN), a state-of-the-art architecture for 3D object recognition, by quantifying the contribution of individual views to classification accuracy and allocating pruning budgets, respectively. Experimental results show that the resulting models satisfy user-specified bounds on accuracy and memory footprint while reducing inference latency by factors ranging from 1.2x to 5.0x across diverse hardware platforms. These findings suggest that performance-aware, view-adaptive compression provides a viable pathway for deploying complex vision models in distributed edge environments.

AI.tldr: SlimEdge提出了一种结合结构化剪枝和多目标优化的方法，用于在受限边缘设备上高效部署分布式DNN（如MVCNN），实现了在满足性能和内存要求的同时，将推理延迟降低了1.2倍到5.0倍。

AI.conclusion: 性能感知、视角自适应的压缩方法为在分布式边缘环境中部署复杂的视觉模型提供了一条可行的途径。
AI.translation: 深度分布式网络（DNN）已成为现代计算机视觉的核心，但由于其庞大的参数量和计算需求，它们在资源受限的边缘设备上的部署仍然受阻。在此，我们提出了一种高效部署分布式DNN的方法，该方法兼顾了硬件限制并保持了任务性能。我们的方法将结构化模型剪枝与多目标优化相结合，以根据异构设备约束来定制网络容量。我们使用多视角卷积神经网络（MVCNN）（一种用于3D物体识别的最新架构）演示了该框架，具体做法是量化单个视角对分类准确性的贡献并相应地分配剪枝预算。实验结果表明，由此产生的模型满足用户指定的准确性和内存占用界限，同时在各种硬件平台上将推理延迟降低了1.2倍至5.0倍。这些发现表明，性能感知、视角自适应的压缩为在分布式边缘环境中部署复杂的视觉模型提供了一条可行的途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SlimEdge框架，旨在解决深度分布式网络（DNN）在资源受限边缘设备上部署困难的问题。该方法结合了结构化模型剪枝和多目标优化，以实现网络容量对异构硬件约束的自适应调整。通过在MVCNN上进行演示，该框架能够根据不同视角对准确性的贡献分配剪枝预算。实验证明，该方法在满足准确性和内存限制的同时，显著降低了推理延迟（1.2倍至5.0倍）。

title: HybridFlow: Adaptive Task Scheduling for Fast and Token-Efficient LLM Inference in Edge-Cloud Collaboration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive reasoning and problem-solving abilities, yet their substantial inference latency and token consumption pose major challenges for real-time deployment on resource-limited edge devices. Recent efforts toward edge-cloud collaboration have attempted to mitigate this issue, but most existing methods adopt coarse-grained task allocation strategies-assigning entire queries either to the edge or the cloud. Such rigid partitioning fails to exploit fine-grained reasoning parallelism and often leads to redundant computation and inefficient resource utilization. To this end, we propose HybridFlow, a resource-adaptive inference framework that enables fast and token-efficient collaborative reasoning between edge and cloud LLMs. HybridFlow operates in two stages: (1) task decomposition and parallel execution, which dynamically splits a complex query into interdependent subtasks that can execute as soon as their dependencies are resolved; and (2) resource-aware subtask routing, where a learned router adaptively assigns each subtask to the edge or cloud model according to predicted utility gains and real-time budget states. Comprehensive evaluations on GPQA, MMLU-Pro, AIME, and LiveBench-Reasoning demonstrate that HybridFlow effectively reduces end-to-end inference time and overall token usage while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.title_translation: HybridFlow：面向边云协作的快速且代币高效的LLM推理的自适应任务调度
AI.tldr: 提出HybridFlow框架，用于边云协作的LLM推理，它使用细粒度任务分解和资源感知路由，比粗粒度方法更快、更节省代币，同时保持准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有边云协作LLM方法采用粗粒度任务分配策略，未能利用细粒度的推理并行性，导致冗余计算和资源利用效率低下。目标是解决LLM在资源有限的边缘设备上部署时面临的巨大推理延迟和代币消耗问题，实现快速且代币高效的实时部署。
AI.method: HybridFlow是一个两阶段的资源自适应推理框架：1) 任务分解和并行执行，动态地将复杂查询拆分为相互依赖的子任务，一旦依赖关系解决即可执行；2) 资源感知子任务路由，一个学习型路由器根据预测的效用增益和实时预算状态，自适应地将每个子任务分配给边缘或云模型。
AI.result: 在GPQA、MMLU-Pro、AIME和LiveBench-Reasoning上的综合评估表明，HybridFlow有效减少了端到端推理时间和总体代币使用量，同时保持了有竞争力的准确性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）展示了令人印象深刻的推理和问题解决能力，但其高昂的推理延迟和代币消耗对资源有限的边缘设备上的实时部署构成了重大挑战。最近的边云协作努力试图缓解这一问题，但现有的大多数方法采用粗粒度的任务分配策略——将整个查询分配给边缘或云端。这种僵硬的划分未能利用细粒度的推理并行性，并且通常导致冗余计算和低效的资源利用。为此，我们提出了HybridFlow，一个资源自适应推理框架，它能够在边缘和云端LLM之间实现快速且代币高效的协作推理。HybridFlow分两个阶段运行：（1）任务分解和并行执行，动态地将复杂查询拆分为相互依赖的子任务，一旦它们的依赖关系得到解决即可执行；（2）资源感知子任务路由，一个学习型路由器根据预测的效用增益和实时预算状态，自适应地将每个子任务分配给边缘或云模型。在GPQA、MMLU-Pro、AIME和LiveBench-Reasoning上的综合评估表明，HybridFlow有效减少了端到端推理时间和总体代币使用量，同时保持了有竞争力的准确性。
AI.summary: HybridFlow是一种面向边云协作LLM推理的资源自适应框架。针对现有粗粒度分配策略效率低下的问题，HybridFlow引入了两阶段方法：首先，它将复杂查询动态分解为可并行执行的相互依赖的子任务；其次，一个学习型路由器根据预测的效用增益和实时资源状态，将这些子任务自适应地路由到边缘或云端模型。实验证明，该方法显著减少了推理时间和代币消耗，并保持了高准确性。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, 边云协作, 任务调度, 资源自适应, 代币效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了细粒度的任务分解和资源感知路由机制，克服了传统边云协作中粗粒度任务分配的限制。通过将复杂推理任务分解为可并行执行的子任务，并根据实时资源状态智能分配，它有效地解决了LLM在边缘设备上部署时面临的延迟和代币效率问题。这代表了边缘AI部署中，从静态、整体分配到动态、模块化协作推理的重要转变。

title: HLS4PC: A Parametrizable Framework For Accelerating Point-Based 3D Point Cloud Models on FPGA
comments: Accepted for publication by 25th International Conference on Embedded Computer Systems: Architectures, Modeling and Simulation (SAMOS 2025)
summary: Point-based 3D point cloud models employ computation and memory intensive mapping functions alongside NN layers for classification/segmentation, and are executed on server-grade GPUs. The sparse, and unstructured nature of 3D point cloud data leads to high memory and computational demand, hindering real-time performance in safety critical applications due to GPU under-utilization. To address this challenge, we present HLS4PC, a parameterizable HLS framework for FPGA acceleration. Our approach leverages FPGA parallelization and algorithmic optimizations to enable efficient fixed-point implementations of both mapping and NN functions. We explore several hardware-aware compression techniques on a state-of-the-art PointMLP-Elite model, including replacing FPS with URS, parameter quantization, layer fusion, and input-points pruning, yielding PointMLP-Lite, a 4x less complex variant with only 2% accuracy drop on ModelNet40. Secondly, we demonstrate that the FPGA acceleration of the PointMLP-Lite results in 3.56x higher throughput than previous works. Furthermore, our implementation achieves 2.3x and 22x higher throughput compared to the GPU and CPU implementations, respectively.
comment: Accepted for publication by 25th International Conference on Embedded Computer Systems: Architectures, Modeling and Simulation (SAMOS 2025)

AI.title_translation: HLS4PC：一种用于在FPGA上加速基于点的3D点云模型的可参数化框架
AI.tldr: 提出了HLS4PC框架，利用FPGA加速和硬件优化（如PointMLP-Lite）来高效执行3D点云模型。该方法在ModelNet40上实现了高吞吐量，比GPU快2.3倍，比CPU快22倍，且精度损失仅为2%。
AI.motivation: 基于点的3D点云模型计算和内存密集，其稀疏、非结构化的特性导致高内存和计算需求，使得在服务器级GPU上难以实现实时性能，尤其是在安全关键应用中，因为GPU利用率不足。
AI.method: 提出了HLS4PC，一个可参数化的HLS（高级综合）框架用于FPGA加速。该方法利用FPGA并行化和算法优化，实现映射函数和NN函数的有效定点实现。具体应用于PointMLP-Elite模型，探索了硬件感知的压缩技术，包括用URS替代FPS、参数量化、层融合和输入点剪枝，从而得到PointMLP-Lite模型。
AI.result: 优化后的PointMLP-Lite模型复杂度降低了4倍，在ModelNet40上精度仅下降2%。FPGA加速的PointMLP-Lite比现有工作吞吐量高3.56倍。与GPU和CPU实现相比，吞吐量分别提高了2.3倍和22倍。
AI.translation: 基于点的3D点云模型使用计算和内存密集型的映射函数以及神经网络层进行分类/分割，并在服务器级GPU上执行。3D点云数据的稀疏和非结构化特性导致高内存和计算需求，由于GPU利用率不足，这阻碍了安全关键应用中的实时性能。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了HLS4PC，一个用于FPGA加速的可参数化HLS框架。我们的方法利用FPGA并行化和算法优化，以实现映射和NN函数的有效定点实现。我们对最先进的PointMLP-Elite模型探索了几种硬件感知压缩技术，包括用URS取代FPS、参数量化、层融合和输入点剪枝，得到了PointMLP-Lite，这是一个复杂度降低4倍但ModelNet40上精度仅下降2%的变体。其次，我们证明了PointMLP-Lite的FPGA加速比以前的工作实现了3.56倍更高的吞吐量。此外，我们的实现与GPU和CPU实现相比，吞吐量分别提高了2.3倍和22倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HLS4PC，一个可参数化的HLS框架，旨在通过FPGA加速解决3D点云模型（如PointMLP-Elite）在GPU上实时性能不足的问题。该框架结合了FPGA并行化和硬件感知优化技术（如URS替换、量化和剪枝），成功创建了复杂度降低4倍的PointMLP-Lite模型，且精度损失微乎其微。实验结果表明，该FPGA实现比现有工作吞吐量提高了3.56倍，且分别比GPU和CPU实现高出2.3倍和22倍。
AI.keywords: 3D点云, FPGA加速, HLS, PointMLP, 硬件压缩
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新性在于将HLS与硬件感知的模型压缩技术相结合，专门针对3D点云模型的特点（稀疏性、非结构化）进行优化，从而有效利用FPGA的并行计算能力。通过创建高度优化的PointMLP-Lite变体，作者成功地解决了传统GPU在处理此类密集计算任务时利用率低的问题，并在保持高精度的同时，实现了显著的吞吐量提升。这对于需要实时处理能力的安全关键型应用（如自动驾驶）具有重要意义。

title: Men and Women Survivors in Science: A Comprehensive Analysis
summary: We followed scientists who started publishing in 2000 and who continued publishing until 2020-2023 (N = 41,424). These survivors in science authored 2 million articles (N = 2,089,097) with more than 70 million cited references (N = 73,118,395) and worked in 38 OECD countries. Using a raw Scopus dataset, we examined gender disparities in publishing intensity, international collaboration, journal selection, productivity, citations, team formation, and publishing breaks in 16 STEMM and social science disciplines. Several author-level metrics were computed. Our data show a gender productivity gap for both lifetime scholarly output and annual journal prestige-normalized productivity. Surprisingly, in the context of extant literature, the data do not show a gender international collaboration gap, a gender journal selection gap, a gender citation gap, or a gender team formation gap. Men were on average 23% more productive than women cumulatively in 2000-2023 and 19% more productive in the last 5 years studied (2019-2023). Men and women published in equally prestigious journals, received the same number of citations (field-normalized), and worked in equally sized teams. In all, 80% of scientists in STEMM disciplines and 70% in the social sciences had published every year. Our data indicate interesting disciplinary differences in gender disparities.

AI.title_translation: 科学界的男性和女性幸存者：一项综合分析
AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2000年至2023年间约41,424名科学家的出版数据，发现男性在学术产出和期刊影响力方面比女性更具生产力，但性别在国际合作、期刊选择、引用次数和团队组成方面没有显著差异。
AI.motivation: 评估科学界性别差距，特别是在出版强度、国际合作、期刊选择、生产力、引用、团队形成和出版中断等方面。
AI.method: 分析了2000年至2023年间41,424名科学家的200万篇文章和7300万条参考文献数据，涵盖38个OECD国家和16个STEMM及社科领域，计算了作者级别的各项指标。
AI.result: 男性在学术产出和期刊影响力方面比女性更具生产力（男性累积生产力高23%，近五年高19%）。然而，在国际合作、期刊选择、引用次数（经过领域标准化后）和团队组成方面未发现性别差距。男女科学家发表的期刊声望相似，获得的引用次数也相似，并且在同样规模的团队中工作。80%的STEMM科学家和70%的社科科学家每年都有发表记录。研究还指出了不同学科在性别差距方面存在的差异。
AI.conclusion: 尽管男性在学术产出和期刊影响力方面比女性更具生产力，但在国际合作、期刊选择、引用次数和团队组成方面，性别之间没有显著差异，这与以往的研究结果有所不同。研究强调了学科差异对性别差距的影响。
AI.translation: 我们追踪了2000年开始发表并持续发表至2020-2023年的科学家（N = 41,424）。这些科学界的幸存者撰写了200万篇文章（N = 2,089,097），引用了超过7000万条参考文献（N = 73,118,395），并在38个OECD国家工作。我们使用原始的Scopus数据集，检查了16个STEMM和社科领域的性别在出版强度、国际合作、期刊选择、生产力、引用、团队形成和出版中断方面的差异。计算了多项作者级别的指标。我们的数据显示，在终身学术产出和年度期刊声望标准化生产力方面，都存在性别生产力差距。令人惊讶的是，在现有文献的背景下，数据显示在性别国际合作差距、性别期刊选择差距、性别引用差距或性别团队形成差距方面没有差异。男性在2000-2023年期间的累积生产力平均比女性高23%，在研究的最后五年（2019-2023年）比女性高19%。男性和女性发表的期刊声望相似，获得的引用次数也相似（经过领域标准化后），并且在同样规模的团队中工作。总的来说，80%的STEMM领域科学家和70%的社科领域科学家的出版记录是每年都有的。我们的数据显示，在性别差距方面存在有趣的学科差异。
AI.summary: 这项研究对41,424名科学家的200万篇论文进行了分析，发现尽管男性在学术产出和期刊影响力方面比女性更具生产力，但在国际合作、期刊选择、引用次数和团队组成方面并未发现性别差距，这与以往的研究有所不同，并指出了学科差异的重要性。
AI.keywords: 性别差距, 科学生产力, 国际合作, 期刊选择, STEMM
AI.comments: 这项研究通过大规模数据集揭示了科学界性别差距的新见解，特别是在生产力和合作方面。研究结果具有重要意义，但也应注意其局限性，例如可能存在未被数据捕捉到的其他形式的性别不平等。

title: International Research Collaboration Among Top Performers: A Gender Gap Persists
summary: We studied gender differences among Polish top performers (the upper 10% of scientists in terms of research productivity) in international research collaborations in 15 STEMM disciplines and over time. We examined five 6-year periods from 1992 to 2021. We operationalized international research collaboration by using international publication co-authorships in Scopus and used a sample of 152,043 unique Polish authors and their 587,558 articles published in 1992-2021. Our data show that a gender gap in international collaboration by top performers (and among the whole population of scientists) steadily widened: the gap was smallest in the early 1990s and grew over the next 30 years. Among top performers, internationalization intensity in four of the disciplines (AGRI, BIO, ENVI, and MED) was higher for men than for women. To capture the multidimensional nature of international research collaboration, we estimated a fractional logistic regression model with fixed effects that confirmed a persisting moderate but statistically significant international collaboration gender gap among top performers. We found an approximately 11% higher probability of international collaboration by men top performers compared with women top performers. Reflections on bibliometric-driven studies are offered.

AI.title_translation: 顶级表现者中的国际研究合作：性别差距依然存在
AI.tldr: 对波兰30年来的顶级科学家数据显示，国际研究合作的性别差距不仅存在，而且在不断加剧，男性比女性更倾向于进行国际合作。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究在波兰顶级科学家群体中，国际研究合作方面是否存在性别差异，以及这种差异随时间的变化趋势。
AI.method: 使用Scopus数据，分析了1992年至2021年间15个STEMM学科中152,043名波兰作者的国际论文合著情况。采用带有固定效应的分数对数回归模型来量化国际合作的性别差距。
AI.result: 数据显示，顶级表现者（以及整个科学家群体）的国际合作性别差距持续扩大，在20世纪90年代初最小，此后30年间不断增长。在四个学科（AGRI, BIO, ENVI, 和 MED）中，男性的国际化强度高于女性。男性顶级科学家的国际合作概率比女性高出约11%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了在波兰顶级表现者中，国际研究合作方面存在持续的、中等但具有统计学意义的性别差距，男性顶级科学家的国际合作概率比女性高出约11%。
AI.translation: 我们研究了波兰顶级表现者（研究生产力排名前10%的科学家）在15个STEMM学科中以及随时间推移的性别差异。我们使用Scopus中的国际论文合著来操作化国际研究合作，样本涵盖了1992年至2021年间发表的152,043名独特的波兰作者及其587,558篇文章。我们的数据显示，顶级表现者（以及整个科学家群体）的国际合作性别差距持续扩大：该差距在20世纪90年代初最小，并在接下来的30年里不断增长。在顶级表现者中，四个学科（AGRI、BIO、ENVI和MED）的国际化强度男性高于女性。为了捕捉国际研究合作的多维度特性，我们估计了一个带有固定效应的分数对数回归模型，证实了在顶级表现者中存在持续的、中等但具有统计学意义的国际合作性别差距。我们发现，男性顶级科学家的国际合作概率比女性高出约11%。文章最后对文献计量驱动的研究进行了反思。
AI.summary: 这项研究分析了波兰1992年至2021年间15个STEMM学科中顶级科学家（前10%）的国际研究合作情况。研究发现，国际合作的性别差距持续扩大，男性顶级科学家的国际合作概率比女性高出约11%，尤其是在四个特定学科中，男性表现出更高的国际化强度。
AI.keywords: 性别差距, 国际研究合作, 顶级表现者, 科学计量学, 波兰科学家
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于它专注于“顶级表现者”（前10%的科学家），并对长达30年的时间跨度进行了追踪分析，揭示了国际合作中的性别差距不仅存在，而且在扩大。其局限性可能在于仅使用了Scopus的国际合作发表作为衡量指标。

title: On Harnessing Idle Compute at the Edge for Foundation Model Training
comments: Extended abstract version of this paper appeared in ACM MobiCom 2025
summary:
The ecosystem behind foundation model development today is highly centralized and limited to large-scale cloud data center operators: training foundation models is costly, needing immense compute resources. Decentralized foundation model training across edge devices, leveraging their spare compute, promises a democratized alternative. However, existing edge-training approaches fall short: they struggle to match cloud-based training performance, exhibit limited scalability with model size, exceed device memory capacity, and have prohibitive communication overhead. They also fail to satisfactorily handle device heterogeneity and dynamism.
  We introduce a new paradigm, Cleave, which finely partitions training operations through a novel selective hybrid tensor parallelism method. Together with a parameter server centric training framework, Cleave copes with device memory limits and avoids communication bottlenecks, thereby enabling efficient training of large models on par with the cloud. Further, with a cost optimization model to guide device selection and training workload distribution, Cleave effectively accounts for device heterogeneity and churn.
  Our evaluations show that Cleave matches cloud-based GPU training by scaling efficiently to larger models and thousands of devices, supporting up to 8x more devices than baseline edge-training approaches. It outperforms state-of-the-art edge training methods by up to a factor of 10 in per-batch training time and efficiently handles device failures, achieving at least 100x faster recovery than prior methods.
comment: Extended abstract version of this paper appeared in ACM MobiCom 2025

AI.title_translation: 关于利用边缘的闲置计算资源进行基础模型训练
AI.tldr: Cleave是一种新的边缘训练范式，它使用创新的张量并行和参数服务器框架，解决了内存和通信瓶颈，使大型基础模型能够在数千台异构的边缘设备上高效训练，性能与云端相当，且故障恢复极快。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型训练高度集中在大型云数据中心，成本高昂。利用边缘设备的空闲计算资源进行去中心化训练，有望实现更民主化的替代方案，但现有方法在性能、可扩展性、内存使用、通信开销和设备异构性处理方面存在不足。
AI.method: Cleave系统通过一种新颖的选择性混合张量并行方法对训练操作进行精细划分，并结合以参数服务器为中心的训练框架，以应对设备内存限制和通信瓶颈。此外，它引入了一个成本优化模型来指导设备选择和训练工作负载分配，以处理设备异构性和动态性。
AI.result: Cleave能高效扩展到更大的模型和数千台设备，支持的设备数量比基线边缘训练方法多出8倍。在每批次训练时间上，Cleave比最先进的边缘训练方法快10倍，并且在处理设备故障时，恢复速度比先前的方法快至少100倍。
AI.conclusion: Cleave成功地实现了与云端GPU训练相匹配的性能，能够高效地扩展到更大的模型和数千台设备，并且在处理设备故障方面表现出极高的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 当今基础模型生态系统高度集中，仅限于大型云数据中心运营商：训练基础模型成本高昂，需要巨大的计算资源。利用边缘设备的空闲计算能力进行去中心化的基础模型训练，有望成为一种民主化的替代方案。然而，现有的边缘训练方法表现不佳：它们难以匹配基于云的训练性能，模型规模的扩展性有限，超出设备内存容量，并且通信开销过高。它们也未能令人满意地处理设备异构性和动态性。我们引入了一种新的范式，Cleave，它通过一种新颖的选择性混合张量并行方法对训练操作进行精细划分。结合以参数服务器为中心的训练框架，Cleave可以应对设备内存限制并避免通信瓶颈，从而能够高效地训练大型模型，性能与云端相当。此外，通过一个成本优化模型来指导设备选择和训练工作负载分配，Cleave有效地考虑了设备异构性和变化。我们的评估表明，Cleave通过高效地扩展到更大的模型和数千台设备，可以匹配基于云的GPU训练，支持的设备数量比基线边缘训练方法多出8倍。它在每批次训练时间上比最先进的边缘训练方法快10倍，并能有效处理设备故障，实现比先前方法至少快100倍的恢复速度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Cleave的新范式，旨在利用边缘设备的闲置计算资源来训练基础模型。Cleave通过选择性混合张量并行和参数服务器中心化框架，解决了现有边缘训练方法在内存、通信和异构性方面的限制，实现了与云端训练相媲美的效率，并展示了出色的可扩展性和故障恢复能力。
AI.keywords: 基础模型训练, 边缘计算, 张量并行, 设备异构性, 分布式训练
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了Cleave系统，通过选择性混合张量并行和参数服务器中心化的训练框架，解决了边缘设备上训练大型基础模型时面临的内存、通信和异构性挑战，实现了与云端训练相媲美的性能，并在可扩展性和故障恢复方面表现出色。其核心贡献在于高效地利用了闲置的边缘计算资源。

title: Pre-review to Peer review: Pitfalls of Automating Reviews using Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models are versatile general-task solvers, and their capabilities can truly assist people with scholarly peer review as \textit{pre-review} agents, if not as fully autonomous \textit{peer-review} agents. While incredibly beneficial, automating academic peer-review, as a concept, raises concerns surrounding safety, research integrity, and the validity of the academic peer-review process. The majority of the studies performing a systematic evaluation of frontier LLMs generating reviews across science disciplines miss the mark on addressing the alignment/misalignment of reviews along with the utility of LLM generated reviews when compared against publication outcomes such as \textbf{Citations}, \textbf{Hit-papers}, \textbf{Novelty}, and \textbf{Disruption}. This paper presents an experimental study in which we gathered ground-truth reviewer ratings from OpenReview and used various frontier open-weight LLMs to generate reviews of papers to gauge the safety and reliability of incorporating LLMs into the scientific review pipeline. Our findings demonstrate the utility of frontier open-weight LLMs as pre-review screening agents despite highlighting fundamental misalignment risks when deployed as autonomous reviewers. Our results show that all models exhibit weak correlation with human peer reviewers (0.15), with systematic overestimation bias of 3-5 points and uniformly high confidence scores (8.0-9.0/10) despite prediction errors. However, we also observed that LLM reviews correlate more strongly with post-publication metrics than with human scores, suggesting potential utility as pre-review screening tools. Our findings highlight the potential and address the pitfalls of automating peer reviews with language models. We open-sourced our dataset $D_{LMRSD}$ to help the research community expand the safety framework of automating scientific reviews.

title: GPU Kernel Optimization Beyond Full Builds: An LLM Framework with Minimal Executable Programs
summary: In high-performance computing, hotspot GPU kernels are primary bottlenecks, and expert manual tuning is costly and hard to port. Large language model methods often assume kernels can be compiled and executed cheaply, which fails in large applications where full builds and runs are expensive. We present an end-to-end LLM framework with performance feedback that optimizes kernels without building the full application. From independently extracted hotspot kernels, it automatically completes code into a Minimal Executable Program (MEP), then performs multi-round iterative optimization and evaluation outside the full application. The framework integrates Automatic Error Repair and Performance Pattern Inheritance to fix faults, preserve correctness, reuse effective tiling/memory/synchronization strategies, and reduce search cost. Optimized variants are reintegrated into the original application for validation. We evaluate on NVIDIA GPUs and the Haiguang Deep Computing Unit (DCU) platform (AMD-licensed architecture) using PolyBench, the AMD APP SDK, and hotspot kernels from large-scale supercomputing applications. The method achieves average speedups of 5.05x (PolyBench on NVIDIA), 7.77x (PolyBench on DCU), 1.77x (AMD APP SDK), and 1.25x on three hotspot kernels, surpassing direct LLM optimization. The approach requires no full-source dependencies, offers cross-platform portability, and enables practical, low-cost GPU kernel optimization.

title: Rethinking Leveraging Pre-Trained Multi-Layer Representations for Speaker Verification
summary: Recent speaker verification studies have achieved notable success by leveraging layer-wise output from pre-trained Transformer models. However, few have explored the advancements in aggregating these multi-level features beyond the static weighted average. We present Layer Attentive Pooling (LAP), a novel strategy for aggregating inter-layer representations from pre-trained speech models for speaker verification. LAP assesses the significance of each layer from multiple perspectives time-dynamically, and employs max pooling instead of averaging. Additionally, we propose a lightweight backend speaker model comprising LAP and Attentive Statistical Temporal Pooling (ASTP) to extract speaker embeddings from pre-trained model output. Experiments on the VoxCeleb benchmark reveal that our compact architecture achieves state-of-the-art performance while greatly reducing the training time. We further analyzed LAP design and its dynamic weighting mechanism for capturing speaker characteristics.

title: Adaptive GPU Resource Allocation for Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning in Serverless Environments
summary: Multi-agent systems powered by large language models have emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex reasoning tasks through collaborative intelligence. However, efficiently deploying these systems on serverless GPU platforms presents significant resource allocation challenges due to heterogeneous agent workloads, varying computational demands, and the need for cost-effective scaling. This paper presents an adaptive GPU resource allocation framework that achieves 85\% latency reduction compared to round-robin scheduling while maintaining comparable throughput to static allocation, using an $O(N)$ complexity algorithm for real-time adaptation. Our approach dynamically allocates GPU resources based on workload characteristics, agent priorities, and minimum resource requirements, enabling efficient utilization while maintaining quality of service. The framework addresses three key challenges: (1) heterogeneous computational demands across lightweight coordinators and heavyweight specialists, (2) dynamic workload fluctuations requiring millisecond-scale reallocation, and (3) capacity constraints in serverless environments. Through comprehensive simulations modeling realistic multi-agent workflows with four heterogeneous agents, we demonstrate that adaptive allocation outperforms static equal and round-robin strategies across latency, cost, and GPU utilization metrics. The framework provides a practical solution for deploying cost-efficient multi-agent AI systems on serverless GPU infrastructure.

title: Towards Unsupervised Causal Representation Learning via Latent Additive Noise Model Causal Autoencoders
summary: Unsupervised representation learning seeks to recover latent generative factors, yet standard methods relying on statistical independence often fail to capture causal dependencies. A central challenge is identifiability: as established in disentangled representation learning and nonlinear ICA literature, disentangling causal variables from observational data is impossible without supervision, auxiliary signals, or strong inductive biases. In this work, we propose the Latent Additive Noise Model Causal Autoencoder (LANCA) to operationalize the Additive Noise Model (ANM) as a strong inductive bias for unsupervised discovery. Theoretically, we prove that while the ANM constraint does not guarantee unique identifiability in the general mixing case, it resolves component-wise indeterminacy by restricting the admissible transformations from arbitrary diffeomorphisms to the affine class. Methodologically, arguing that the stochastic encoding inherent to VAEs obscures the structural residuals required for latent causal discovery, LANCA employs a deterministic Wasserstein Auto-Encoder (WAE) coupled with a differentiable ANM Layer. This architecture transforms residual independence from a passive assumption into an explicit optimization objective. Empirically, LANCA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on synthetic physics benchmarks (Pendulum, Flow), and on photorealistic environments (CANDLE), where it demonstrates superior robustness to spurious correlations arising from complex background scenes.

title: Practical challenges of control monitoring in frontier AI deployments
summary: Automated control monitors could play an important role in overseeing highly capable AI agents that we do not fully trust. Prior work has explored control monitoring in simplified settings, but scaling monitoring to real-world deployments introduces additional dynamics: parallel agent instances, non-negligible oversight latency, incremental attacks between agent instances, and the difficulty of identifying scheming agents based on individual harmful actions. In this paper, we analyse design choices to address these challenges, focusing on three forms of monitoring with different latency-safety trade-offs: synchronous, semi-synchronous, and asynchronous monitoring. We introduce a high-level safety case sketch as a tool for understanding and comparing these monitoring protocols. Our analysis identifies three challenges -- oversight, latency, and recovery -- and explores them in four case studies of possible future AI deployments.

title: A Robust framework for sound event localization and detection on real recordings
comments: Technical Report submitted to DCASE 2022 Challenge Task 3 (Winner of the Judge's Award)
summary: This technical report describes the systems submitted to the DCASE2022 challenge task 3: sound event localization and detection (SELD). The task aims to detect occurrences of sound events and specify their class, furthermore estimate their position. Our system utilizes a ResNet-based model under a proposed robust framework for SELD. To guarantee the generalized performance on the real-world sound scenes, we design the total framework with augmentation techniques, a pipeline of mixing datasets from real-world sound scenes and emulations, and test time augmentation. Augmentation techniques and exploitation of external sound sources enable training diverse samples and keeping the opportunity to train the real-world context enough by maintaining the number of the real recording samples in the batch. In addition, we design a test time augmentation and a clustering-based model ensemble method to aggregate confident predictions. Experimental results show that the model under a proposed framework outperforms the baseline methods and achieves competitive performance in real-world sound recordings.
comment: Technical Report submitted to DCASE 2022 Challenge Task 3 (Winner of the Judge's Award)

title: Oignon: Citation Graph Tool
summary: Citation graph visualisation is a useful tool for contextual awareness in academic research. Unfortunately, existing solutions can suffer from several drawbacks, such as a poor scaling, shallow network traversal, freemium gating, and slow build times. Oignon is a free, open-source tool for systematically exploring academic research. It uses a dual-path ranking system with recency weighting to create graphs capturing both foundational works and recent breakthroughs related to a specific publication.

title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Lean Startup Methodology: A Bibliometric Analysis of Research Trends and Future Directions
comments: Revised version (19 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables) following minor journal-review comments; currently under journal review
summary: This study presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of the emerging intersection between artificial intelligence (AI) and lean startup methodology. Using the PRISMA 2020 framework, we systematically analyzed 12 peer-reviewed articles published between 2010 and June 2025, sourced from the Scopus database. The analysis employed VOS viewer software to conduct co-authorship, keyword co-occurrence, and citation network analyses. Results reveal three distinct research clusters: operational integration of AI within startup experimentation processes, AI-enhanced learning systems for entrepreneurial contexts, and strategic implications of AI for uncertainty management in startups. The findings indicate a developing research domain characterized by fragmented authorship networks, limited international collaboration, and geographic concentration in developed economies, particularly the United States and Germany. Key research themes include business model innovation, iterative methods, and machine learning applications, with artificial intelligence serving as a bridging concept across thematic clusters. The analysis identifies significant research gaps in ethical considerations, cross-cultural validation, and empirical testing of AI-enabled lean startup frameworks. While current research demonstrates growing interest in AI integration within entrepreneurial experimentation, the field requires enhanced theoretical consolidation, methodological rigor, and interdisciplinary collaboration to achieve practical relevance and academic maturity. This study contributes to the emerging discourse on digital entrepreneurship by providing a systematic overview of research trends and identifying priority areas for future investigation at the intersection of AI and lean startup methodologies.
comment: Revised version (19 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables) following minor journal-review comments; currently under journal review

title: Marco-ASR: A Principled and Metric-Driven Framework for Fine-Tuning Large-Scale ASR Models for Domain Adaptation
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models have achieved remarkable accuracy in general settings, yet their performance often degrades in domain-specific applications due to data mismatch and linguistic variability. This challenge is amplified for modern Large Language Model (LLM)-based ASR systems, whose massive scale and complex training dynamics make effective fine-tuning non-trivial. To address this gap, this paper proposes a principled and metric-driven fine-tuning framework for adapting both traditional and LLM-based ASR models to specialized domains. The framework emphasizes learning rate optimization based on performance metrics, combined with domain-specific data transformation and augmentation. We empirically evaluate our framework on state-of-the-art models, including Whisper, Whisper-Turbo, and Qwen2-Audio, across multi-domain, multilingual, and multi-length datasets. Our results not only validate the proposed framework but also establish practical protocols for improving domain-specific ASR performance while preventing overfitting.

title: AudioGAN: A Compact and Efficient Framework for Real-Time High-Fidelity Text-to-Audio Generation
comments: 10 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to AES AIMLA 2025
summary: Text-to-audio (TTA) generation can significantly benefit the media industry by reducing production costs and enhancing work efficiency. However, most current TTA models (primarily diffusion-based) suffer from slow inference speeds and high computational costs. In this paper, we introduce AudioGAN, the first successful Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)-based TTA framework that generates audio in a single pass, thereby reducing model complexity and inference time. To overcome the inherent difficulties in training GANs, we integrate multiple ,contrastive losses and propose innovative components Single-Double-Triple (SDT) Attention and Time-Frequency Cross-Attention (TF-CA). Extensive experiments on the AudioCaps dataset demonstrate that AudioGAN achieves state-of-the-art performance while using 90% fewer parameters and running 20 times faster, synthesizing audio in under one second. These results establish AudioGAN as a practical and powerful solution for real-time TTA.
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to AES AIMLA 2025

title: IANEC: Digital Forensic Investigation of Contemporary Writers' Archives
summary: The IANEC project (Investigation of Digital Archives of Contemporary Writers), led by the GREYC Research Lab and funded by the French Ministry of Culture aims to develop dedicated digital forensic investigation tools to automate the analysis of archival corpora from the Institut M{é}moires de l'{É}dition Contemporaine (IMEC). The project is based on the observation that born-digital archival materials are increasingly prevalent in contemporary archival institutions, and that digital forensics technologies have become essential for the extraction, identification, processing, and description of natively digital archival corpora.*

title: TL: Automatic End-to-End Compiler of Tile-Based Languages for Spatial Dataflow Architectures
summary: Spatial dataflow accelerators are a promising direction for next-generation computer systems because they can reduce the memory bottlenecks of traditional von Neumann machines such as CPUs and GPUs. They do so by organizing computation around explicit, compiler-managed data movement over the on-chip network, allowing operands to be directly forwarded between processing elements and reducing reliance on high-latency, bandwidth-limited global shared memory. Such localized communications can provide higher throughput and efficiency compared to repeated off-chip memory accesses. However, their end-to-end performance depends strongly on how workloads are mapped to the hardware. Naive mappings can perform very poorly, and most users rely on hand-tuned vendor libraries. In practice, although existing spatial-dataflow accelerators have strong potential for high performance, energy- and cost-efficiency, their limited programmability remains a major barrier to their wider adoption. This paper presents TL, an end-to-end framework that compiles tile-based programs (such as Triton kernels) onto spatial dataflow architectures. Unlike most existing compiler frameworks that focus on optimizing code generation within a single tile, TL addresses the central challenge of distributing tile instances across spatially distributed cores and exploiting the on-chip network and distributed memories to increase data reuse and reduce communications. TL proposes a hardware representation that captures interconnect topology, memory hierarchy, and compute capabilities, enabling both specialized architecture-specific optimizations and support for diverse spatial dataflow targets. TL is built on the MLIR ecosystem and defines a generic entry point for different front-ends and an end point for different back-ends.

title: SoliReward: Mitigating Susceptibility to Reward Hacking and Annotation Noise in Video Generation Reward Models
summary: Post-training alignment of video generation models with human preferences is a critical goal. Developing effective Reward Models (RMs) for this process faces significant methodological hurdles. Current data collection paradigms, reliant on in-prompt pairwise annotations, suffer from labeling noise. Concurrently, the architectural design of VLM-based RMs, particularly their output mechanisms, remains underexplored. Furthermore, RM is susceptible to reward hacking in post-training. To mitigate these limitations, we propose SoliReward, a systematic framework for video RM training. Our framework first sources high-quality, cost-efficient data via single-item binary annotations, then constructs preference pairs using a cross-prompt pairing strategy. Architecturally, we employ a Hierarchical Progressive Query Attention mechanism to enhance feature aggregation. Finally, we introduce a modified BT loss that explicitly accommodates win-tie scenarios. This approach regularizes the RM's score distribution for positive samples, providing more nuanced preference signals to alleviate over-focus on a small number of top-scoring samples. Our approach is validated on benchmarks evaluating physical plausibility, subject deformity, and semantic alignment, demonstrating improvements in direct RM evaluation metrics and in the efficacy of post-training on video generation models. Code and benchmark will be publicly available.

title: Solving Multi-Agent Multi-Goal Path Finding Problems in Polynomial Time
summary: In this paper, we plan missions for a fleet of agents in undirected graphs, such as grids, with multiple goals. In contrast to regular multi-agent path-finding, the solver finds and updates the assignment of goals to the agents on its own. In the continuous case for a point agent with motions in the Euclidean plane, the problem can be solved arbitrarily close to optimal. For discrete variants that incur node and edge conflicts, we show that it can be solved in polynomial time, which is unexpected, since traditional vehicle routing on general graphs is NP-hard. We implement a corresponding planner that finds conflict-free optimized routes for the agents. Global assignment strategies greatly reduce the number of conflicts, with the remaining ones resolved by elaborating on the concept of ants-on-the-stick, by solving local assignment problems, by interleaving agent paths, and by kicking agents that have already arrived out of their destinations

title: AiiDAlab: on the route to accelerate science
summary: With the availability of ever-increasing computational capabilities, robust and automated research workflows are essential to enable and facilitate the execution and orchestration of large numbers of interdependent simulations in supercomputer facilities. However, the execution of these workflows still typically requires technical expertise in setting up calculation inputs, interpreting outputs, and handling the complexity of parallel code execution on remote machines. To address these challenges, the AiiDAlab platform was developed, making complex computational workflows accessible through an intuitive user interface that runs in a web browser. Here, we discuss how AiiDAlab has matured over the past few years, shifting its focus from computational materials science to become a powerful platform that accelerates scientific discovery across multiple disciplines. Thanks to its design, AiiDAlab allows scientists to focus on their research rather than on computational details and challenges, while keeping automatically track of the full simulation provenance via the underlying AiiDA engine and thus ensuring reproducibility. In particular, we discuss its adoption into quantum chemistry, atmospheric modeling, battery research, and even experimental data analysis at large-scale facilities, while also being actively used in educational settings. Driven by user feedback, significant effort has been made to simplify user onboarding, streamline access to computational resources, and provide robust mechanisms to work with large datasets. Furthermore, AiiDAlab is being integrated with electronic laboratory notebooks (ELNs), reinforcing adherence to the FAIR principles and supporting researchers in data-centric scientific disciplines in easily generating reproducible Open Research Data (ORD).

AI.tldr: AiiDAlab 是一个基于网络的平台，通过提供直观的用户界面，使科学家能够访问复杂的计算工作流，从而加速跨多个学科的科学发现。它简化了用户入门、计算资源访问和处理大型数据集，并与电子实验室笔记本集成，以确保可重复性并支持开放研究数据。
AI.motivation: 随着计算能力的不断提高，需要强大的自动化研究工作流来执行和协调大规模的模拟。然而，这些工作流的执行通常需要专业知识来设置输入、解释输出以及处理并行代码执行的复杂性。AiiDAlab 旨在解决这些挑战，使复杂的计算工作流能够通过直观的 Web 界面进行访问。
AI.method: AiiDAlab 平台通过提供直观的用户界面，使科学家能够访问复杂的计算工作流，并自动跟踪所有模拟的来源，以确保可重复性。该平台还简化了用户入门、计算资源访问和处理大型数据集的机制。
AI.result: AiiDAlab 已从计算材料科学领域扩展到包括化学、大气建模、电池研究和实验数据分析等多个学科，并在教育领域得到应用。它通过简化用户体验、改善资源访问和数据处理能力，并与电子实验室笔记本集成，从而加速了科学发现。
AI.conclusion: AiiDAlab 已成为一个强大的平台，通过简化计算工作流并确保可重复性，在多个学科中加速科学发现。它通过用户反馈不断改进，并致力于支持数据驱动的科学研究。
AI.translation: 随着计算能力的不断提高，健壮的自动化研究工作流对于在超级计算设施中执行和协调大量相互依赖的模拟至关重要。然而，这些工作流的执行通常仍需要专业知识来设置计算输入、解释输出以及处理在远程机器上执行并行代码的复杂性。为了应对这些挑战，AiiDAlab 平台应运而生，通过运行在 Web 浏览器中的直观用户界面，使复杂的计算工作流易于访问。在这里，我们讨论了 AiiDAlab 在过去几年中的发展情况，其重点已从计算材料科学转向成为加速跨多个学科科学发现的强大平台。得益于其设计，AiiDAlab 使科学家能够专注于他们的研究，而不是计算细节和挑战，同时通过底层的 AiiDA 引擎自动跟踪完整的模拟来源，从而确保了可重复性。特别地，我们讨论了它在量子化学、大气建模、电池研究，甚至在大型设施的实验数据分析中的应用，同时它也积极地被用于教育环境。在用户反馈的驱动下，我们付出了巨大的努力来简化用户入门、简化对计算资源的访问，并提供处理大型数据集的健壮机制。此外，AiiDAlab 正在与电子实验室笔记本 (ELN) 集成，加强对 FAIR 原则的遵守，并支持数据中心科学领域的研究人员轻松生成可重复的开放研究数据 (ORD)。
AI.summary: AiiDAlab 是一个基于 Web 的平台，它通过提供直观的用户界面，使复杂的计算工作流易于访问，从而加速了跨多个学科的科学发现。它简化了用户入门、计算资源访问和处理大型数据集的机制，并与电子实验室笔记本集成，以确保可重复性并支持开放研究数据。
AI.keywords: AiiDAlab, 计算工作流, 科学发现, 可重复性, 开放研究数据
AI.comments: 该平台通过用户友好的界面和对可重复性的关注，显著降低了科学研究中计算工作的门槛。其跨学科的应用和与 ELN 的集成是其在加速科学发现方面的关键优势。

title: BitFlipScope: Scalable Fault Localization and Recovery for Bit-Flip Corruptions in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in practical and safety-critical settings are increasingly susceptible to bit-flip faults caused by hardware degradation, cosmic radiation, or deliberate fault-injection attacks such as Rowhammer. These faults silently corrupt internal parameters and can lead to unpredictable or dangerous model behavior. Localizing these corruptions is essential: without identifying the affected region, it is impossible to diagnose the source of degradation, apply targeted corrective measures, or restore model functionality without resorting to costly fine-tuning or full retraining. This work introduces BitFlipScope, a scalable, software-based framework for identifying fault-affected regions within transformer architectures under two deployment scenarios. When a clean reference model is available, BitFlipScope performs differential analysis of outputs, hidden states, and internal activations for detecting anomalous behavior indicative of corruption to pinpoint or localize faults. When no reference model exists, it uses residual-path perturbation and loss-sensitivity profiling to infer the fault-impacted region directly from the corrupted model. In both settings, the framework not only enables effective fault diagnosis but also supports lightweight performance recovery without fine-tuning, offering a practical path to restoring corrupted models. Together, these capabilities make BitFlipScope an important step toward trustworthy, fault-resilient LLM deployment in hardware-prone and adversarial environments.

AI.title_translation: BitFlipScope：用于LLM中位翻转损坏的可扩展故障定位与恢复方案
AI.tldr: BitFlipScope是一个无需重新训练的软件框架，用于在LLM中快速找到并修复由位翻转引起的硬件/攻击错误，提高了模型在恶劣环境下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 部署在实际和安全关键环境中的大型语言模型容易受到硬件降级、宇宙射线或故意攻击（如Rowhammer）引起的位翻转故障的影响，这可能导致不可预测或危险的模型行为，因此需要定位和恢复这些损坏。
AI.method: 在有干净参考模型时，BitFlipScope执行输出、隐藏状态和内部激活的差异化分析以定位故障；在无参考模型时，它利用残差路径扰动和损失敏感度分析来推断受影响的区域。两种场景都支持轻量级的性能恢复。
AI.result: 该框架成功实现了有效的故障诊断，并支持轻量级的性能恢复，而无需进行微调或完全再训练。
AI.conclusion: BitFlipScope为在易受硬件影响和对抗性环境中部署可信赖、容错的LLM提供了一条实用的途径，它不仅实现了有效的故障诊断，还支持轻量级的性能恢复。
AI.translation: 部署在实际和安全关键环境中的大型语言模型越来越容易受到由硬件退化、宇宙射线或故意故障注入攻击（如Rowhammer）引起的位翻转故障的影响。这些故障会静默地破坏内部参数，并可能导致不可预测或危险的模型行为。定位这些损坏至关重要：如果不确定受影响的区域，就不可能诊断退化的根源、应用有针对性的纠正措施，或在不诉诸昂贵的微调或完全重新训练的情况下恢复模型功能。这项工作引入了BitFlipScope，一个用于在两种部署场景下识别变压器架构中故障影响区域的可扩展、基于软件的框架。当有干净的参考模型时，BitFlipScope执行输出、隐藏状态和内部激活的差异化分析，以检测指示损坏的异常行为，从而精确定位故障。当没有参考模型时，它使用残差路径扰动和损失敏感度分析，直接从损坏的模型中推断出故障影响的区域。在两种设置中，该框架不仅实现了有效的故障诊断，还支持轻量级的性能恢复，而无需微调，为恢复损坏的模型提供了一条实用的途径。总而言之，这些能力使BitFlipScope成为迈向在易受硬件影响和对抗性环境中部署可信赖、容错的LLM的重要一步。
AI.summary: BitFlipScope是一个可扩展的软件框架，用于定位和恢复大型语言模型（LLM）中由位翻转引起的故障。它通过差异化分析（有参考模型时）或残差路径扰动和损失敏感度分析（无参考模型时）来识别受影响的区域，并支持轻量级的性能恢复，从而增强了LLM在易受攻击环境中的可信赖性。
AI.keywords: 位翻转, 故障定位, LLM, 容错, Rowhammer
AI.comments: BitFlipScope的创新之处在于提供了一个无需昂贵再训练或微调的、可扩展的软件框架，用于在两种不同场景下定位和恢复LLM中的位翻转错误。其重要性在于提升了LLM在易受硬件错误和对抗性攻击环境中的可信度和弹性。局限性在于其有效性依赖于硬件错误是局部位翻转，且在无参考模型场景下的恢复是“轻量级”的，可能不如完全重训练的效果。

title: Characterizing Motion Encoding in Video Diffusion Timesteps
summary: Text-to-video diffusion models synthesize temporal motion and spatial appearance through iterative denoising, yet how motion is encoded across timesteps remains poorly understood. Practitioners often exploit the empirical heuristic that early timesteps mainly shape motion and layout while later ones refine appearance, but this behavior has not been systematically characterized. In this work, we proxy motion encoding in video diffusion timesteps by the trade-off between appearance editing and motion preservation induced when injecting new conditions over specified timestep ranges, and characterize this proxy through a large-scale quantitative study. This protocol allows us to factor motion from appearance by quantitatively mapping how they compete along the denoising trajectory. Across diverse architectures, we consistently identify an early, motion-dominant regime and a later, appearance-dominant regime, yielding an operational motion-appearance boundary in timestep space. Building on this characterization, we simplify current one-shot motion customization paradigm by restricting training and inference to the motion-dominant regime, achieving strong motion transfer without auxiliary debiasing modules or specialized objectives. Our analysis turns a widely used heuristic into a spatiotemporal disentanglement principle, and our timestep-constrained recipe can serve as ready integration into existing motion transfer and editing methods.

AI.title_translation: 视频扩散时间步中的运动编码表征
AI.tldr: 早期时间步主要影响运动和布局，后期时间步主要影响外观，这种现象已被量化。
AI.motivation: 文本到视频扩散模型在合成时间运动和空间外观时，其运动如何在不同时间步中被编码仍然不清楚。
AI.method: 通过在指定时间步范围内注入新条件时，外观编辑与运动保留之间的权衡来代理运动编码，并通过大规模定量研究来表征这种代理。
AI.result: 在不同的模型架构中，一致地识别出一个早期的、以运动为主的阶段和一个后期的、以外观为主的阶段，从而在时间步空间中形成一个操作性的运动-外观边界。
AI.conclusion: 基于这种表征，通过将训练和推理限制在以运动为主的阶段，简化了当前的单次运动定制范式，在没有辅助去偏模块或专门目标的情况下实现了强大的运动迁移。该分析将一个广泛使用的启发式方法转化为时空解耦的原理，并且所提出的时间步约束方法可以轻松集成到现有的运动迁移和编辑方法中。
AI.translation: 文本到视频扩散模型通过迭代去噪来合成时间运动和空间外观，但运动如何在时间步中被编码仍然知之甚少。实践者经常利用这样一个经验性启发式方法，即早期时间步主要塑造运动和布局，而后期时间步则完善外观，但这种行为尚未得到系统性的表征。在本研究中，我们通过在指定时间步范围内注入新条件时引起的外观编辑与运动保留之间的权衡来代理视频扩散时间步中的运动编码，并通过大规模定量研究来表征这种代理。该协议使我们能够通过量化它们在去噪轨迹中的竞争方式来将运动与外观分离。在各种架构中，我们一致地识别出一个早期的、以运动为主的区域和一个后期的、以外观为主的区域，从而在时间步空间中产生一个操作性的运动-外观边界。基于这种表征，我们通过将训练和推理限制在以运动为主的区域来简化当前的一次性运动定制范式，在没有辅助去偏模块或专门目标的情况下实现了强大的运动迁移。我们的分析将一个广泛使用的启发式方法转化为时空解耦原理，我们的时间步约束方法可以作为现成集成到现有的运动迁移和编辑方法中。
AI.summary: 该研究量化了视频扩散模型中运动和外观信息在不同时间步中的编码方式，发现早期时间步主要负责运动，后期时间步主要负责外观。基于此发现，提出了一种简化的运动定制方法，通过限制模型在运动主导阶段进行训练和推理，从而在不使用额外模块的情况下实现有效的运动迁移。
AI.keywords: 运动编码,视频扩散模型,时间步,外观编辑,运动迁移
AI.comments: 这项研究通过量化分析填补了视频扩散模型中运动编码机制的空白，为理解和优化运动迁移任务提供了新的视角。其提出的时间步约束方法简单有效，具有很高的应用潜力。

title: Real-Time American Sign Language Recognition Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks and LSTM: Architecture, Training, and Deployment
comments: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Patent pending (US 63/918,518). Code available at https://github.com/dawnenakey/spokhandSLR
summary: This paper presents a real-time American Sign Language (ASL) recognition system utilizing a hybrid deep learning architecture combining 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3D CNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The system processes webcam video streams to recognize word-level ASL signs, addressing communication barriers for over 70 million deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals worldwide. Our architecture leverages 3D convolutions to capture spatial-temporal features from video frames, followed by LSTM layers that model sequential dependencies inherent in sign language gestures. Trained on the WLASL dataset (2,000 common words), ASL-LEX lexical database (~2,700 signs), and a curated set of 100 expert-annotated ASL signs, the system achieves F1-scores ranging from 0.71 to 0.99 across sign classes. The model is deployed on AWS infrastructure with edge deployment capability on OAK-D cameras for real-time inference. We discuss the architecture design, training methodology, evaluation metrics, and deployment considerations for practical accessibility applications.

AI.title_translation: 使用3D卷积神经网络和LSTM进行实时美国手语识别：架构、训练与部署
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了一种结合3D CNN和LSTM的深度学习模型，用于实时识别美国手语，并在多个数据集上取得了良好的识别效果，同时实现了云端和边缘设备的部署。
AI.motivation: 解决全球超过7000万听障人士的交流障碍。
AI.method: 利用3D卷积网络捕获视频帧中的空间-时间特征，随后使用LSTM层对与手语手势固有的序列依赖性进行建模。
AI.result: 在WLASL、ASL-LEX和专家注释数据集上训练后，系统在不同手语类别上实现了0.71到0.99的F1分数。模型已部署在AWS基础设施上，并具备在OAK-D摄像头上进行边缘部署的能力。
AI.conclusion: 我们讨论了架构设计、训练方法、评估指标和部署考量，以实现实际可访问性应用。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种利用3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）与长短期记忆（LSTM）网络相结合的混合深度学习架构的实时美国手语（ASL）识别系统。该系统处理网络摄像头视频流以识别词级ASL手势，解决了全球超过7000万听障人士的交流障碍。我们的架构利用3D卷积来捕获视频帧中的空间-时间特征，随后是LSTM层，用于对固有的手语手势序列依赖性进行建模。该系统在WLASL数据集（2,000个常用词）、ASL-LEX词汇数据库（约2,700个手势）以及一套精选的100个专家注释的ASL手势上进行了训练，在不同手势类别上实现了0.71到0.99的F1分数。该模型已部署在AWS基础设施上，并具备在OAK-D摄像头上进行边缘部署以实现实时推理的能力。我们讨论了架构设计、训练方法、评估指标和部署方面的考虑因素，以实现实际的可访问性应用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）混合架构的实时美国手语（ASL）识别系统。该系统通过处理网络摄像头视频流来识别词级ASL手势，并在多个数据集上进行了训练，实现了高F1分数，并已成功部署到云端和边缘设备上。
AI.keywords: 实时识别, 美国手语, 3D CNN, LSTM, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了3D CNN的空间-时间特征提取能力和LSTM的序列建模能力，构建了一个用于实时ASL识别的混合深度学习模型。其实际部署能力（AWS和OAK-D）强调了其在实际应用中的价值。限制方面，虽然使用了多个数据集，但抽象中未明确说明模型在不同场景下的鲁棒性或泛化能力。

title: Wireless Traffic Prediction with Large Language Model
summary: The growing demand for intelligent, adaptive resource management in next-generation wireless networks has underscored the importance of accurate and scalable wireless traffic prediction. While recent advancements in deep learning and foundation models such as large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising forecasting capabilities, they largely overlook the spatial dependencies inherent in city-scale traffic dynamics. In this paper, we propose TIDES (Traffic Intelligence with DeepSeek-Enhanced Spatial-temporal prediction), a novel LLM-based framework that captures spatial-temporal correlations for urban wireless traffic prediction. TIDES first identifies heterogeneous traffic patterns across regions through a clustering mechanism and trains personalized models for each region to balance generalization and specialization. To bridge the domain gap between numerical traffic data and language-based models, we introduce a prompt engineering scheme that embeds statistical traffic features as structured inputs. Furthermore, we design a DeepSeek module that enables spatial alignment via cross-domain attention, allowing the LLM to leverage information from spatially related regions. By fine-tuning only lightweight components while freezing core LLM layers, TIDES achieves efficient adaptation to domain-specific patterns without incurring excessive training overhead. Extensive experiments on real-world cellular traffic datasets demonstrate that TIDES significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both prediction accuracy and robustness. Our results indicate that integrating spatial awareness into LLM-based predictors is the key to unlocking scalable and intelligent network management in future 6G systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于大语言模型的无线流量预测
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为TIDES的新型大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于城市无线流量预测，该框架能够捕捉时空相关性。通过聚类识别不同区域的流量模式，并为每个区域训练个性化模型。通过提示工程将统计流量特征嵌入结构化输入，并引入DeepSeek模块实现空间对齐。TIDES通过微调轻量级组件实现高效适应，实验证明其在预测准确性和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 下一代无线网络需要智能、自适应的资源管理，因此准确、可扩展的无线流量预测至关重要。现有模型忽略了城市交通的时空依赖性。
AI.method: 提出TIDES框架，利用大语言模型进行时空预测。首先通过聚类识别异构流量模式，然后训练个性化模型。设计了提示工程方案将统计流量特征作为结构化输入，并引入DeepSeek模块实现空间对齐。通过微调轻量级组件实现高效适应。
AI.result: TIDES在真实世界蜂窝流量数据集上的实验表明，其在预测准确性和鲁棒性方面显著优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将空间感知能力集成到基于LLM的预测器中是实现未来6G系统中可扩展、智能网络管理的关键。
AI.translation: 下一代无线网络对智能、自适应资源管理日益增长的需求，凸显了准确、可扩展的无线流量预测的重要性。虽然近期深度学习和基础模型（如大语言模型，LLM）在预测能力方面取得了显著进展，但它们在很大程度上忽略了城市规模交通动态中固有的空间依赖性。在本研究中，我们提出TIDES（Traffic Intelligence with DeepSeek-Enhanced Spatial-temporal prediction），一个新颖的基于LLM的框架，用于捕捉城市无线流量预测中的时空相关性。TIDES首先通过聚类机制识别跨区域的异构流量模式，并为每个区域训练个性化模型，以平衡泛化和专业化。为了弥合数值流量数据与基于语言的模型之间的领域差距，我们引入了一种提示工程方案，将统计流量特征嵌入结构化输入。此外，我们设计了一个DeepSeek模块，通过跨域注意实现空间对齐，使LLM能够利用来自空间相关区域的信息。通过仅微调轻量级组件而冻结核心LLM层，TIDES能够在不产生过多训练开销的情况下实现对领域特定模式的高效适应。在真实世界蜂窝流量数据集上的广泛实验表明，TIDES在预测准确性和鲁棒性方面均显著优于最先进的基线方法。我们的结果表明，将空间感知能力集成到基于LLM的预测器中是实现未来6G系统中可扩展、智能网络管理的关??键。
AI.summary: 本研究提出TIDES，一个创新的大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于解决城市无线流量预测中的时空依赖性问题。TIDES通过聚类识别区域流量模式，并为各区域训练个性化模型，同时利用提示工程和DeepSeek模块实现空间信息整合。该方法通过高效微调实现对领域特定模式的适应，并在实验中显著优于现有技术，为未来6G智能网络管理提供了关键见解。
AI.keywords: 无线流量预测,大语言模型,时空相关性,TIDES,DeepSeek
AI.comments: 该研究成功地将大语言模型应用于无线流量预测，并解决了现有模型忽略时空依赖性的问题。通过引入聚类、个性化模型、提示工程和DeepSeek模块，TIDES实现了高效且准确的预测。然而，对于大规模部署的计算成本和实际应用中的鲁棒性仍需进一步探讨。

title: Latent Sculpting for Zero-Shot Generalization: A Manifold Learning Approach to Out-of-Distribution Anomaly Detection
summary: A fundamental limitation of supervised deep learning in high-dimensional tabular domains is "Generalization Collapse": models learn precise decision boundaries for known distributions but fail catastrophically when facing Out-of-Distribution (OOD) data. We hypothesize that this failure stems from the lack of topological constraints in the latent space, resulting in diffuse manifolds where novel anomalies remain statistically indistinguishable from benign data. To address this, we propose Latent Sculpting, a hierarchical two-stage representation learning framework. Stage 1 utilizes a hybrid 1D-CNN and Transformer Encoder trained with a novel Dual-Centroid Compactness Loss (DCCL) to actively "sculpt" benign traffic into a low-entropy, hyperspherical cluster. Unlike standard contrastive losses that rely on triplet mining, DCCL optimizes global cluster centroids to enforce absolute manifold density. Stage 2 conditions a Masked Autoregressive Flow (MAF) on this pre-structured manifold to learn an exact density estimate. We evaluate this methodology on the rigorous CIC-IDS-2017 benchmark, treating it as a proxy for complex, non-stationary data streams. Empirical results demonstrate that explicit manifold sculpting is a prerequisite for robust zero-shot generalization. While supervised baselines suffered catastrophic performance collapse on unseen distribution shifts (F1 approx 0.30) and the strongest unsupervised baseline achieved only 0.76, our framework achieved an F1-Score of 0.87 on strictly zero-shot anomalies. Notably, we report an 88.89% detection rate on "Infiltration" scenarios--a complex distributional shift where state-of-the-art supervised models achieved 0.00% accuracy. These findings suggest that decoupling structure learning from density estimation provides a scalable path toward generalized anomaly detection.

AI.title_translation: 用于零样本泛化的潜空间雕塑：一种流形学习方法在分布外异常检测中的应用
AI.tldr: 深度学习在OOD数据上表现差是因为潜空间没有拓扑结构。我们提出“潜空间雕塑”：第一步，用一种新的损失函数（DCCL）把好数据压成一个紧密的球；第二步，用流模型（MAF）学习这个球的精确密度。结果显示，这种结构化方法在零样本异常检测中表现出色，远超传统方法。
AI.motivation: 有监督深度学习在高维表格域中存在“泛化崩溃”问题，即模型在面对分布外（OOD）数据时会灾难性失败。作者假设这种失败源于潜空间中缺乏拓扑约束，导致流形弥散，使得新颖的异常与良性数据在统计上无法区分。
AI.method: 提出一个分层的两阶段表示学习框架“潜空间雕塑”。第一阶段使用混合1D-CNN和Transformer编码器，结合新颖的双中心紧凑性损失（DCCL）来主动将良性流量塑造成一个低熵、超球形的簇。第二阶段以这个预先结构的流形为条件，训练一个掩码自回归流（MAF）来学习精确的密度估计。
AI.result: 在CIC-IDS-2017基准测试中，相对于遭受灾难性性能崩溃的监督基线（F1约0.30）和最强无监督基线（0.76），该框架在严格的零样本异常上取得了0.87的F1分数。在复杂的“渗透”场景中，检测率达到88.89%，而最先进的监督模型准确率为0.00%。
AI.conclusion: 明确的流形雕塑是实现稳健零样本泛化的先决条件，将结构学习与密度估计解耦为可扩展的通用异常检测提供了一条途径。
AI.translation: 有监督深度学习在高维表格域中的一个基本限制是“泛化崩溃”：模型学习了已知分布的精确决策边界，但在面对分布外（OOD）数据时会灾难性地失败。我们假设这种失败源于潜空间中缺乏拓扑约束，导致流形弥散，使得新颖的异常在统计上与良性数据无法区分。为此，我们提出了潜空间雕塑，一个分层的两阶段表示学习框架。第一阶段利用混合1D-CNN和Transformer编码器，并采用新颖的双中心紧凑性损失（DCCL）进行训练，以主动将良性流量“雕塑”成一个低熵的、超球形的簇。与依赖三元组挖掘的标准对比损失不同，DCCL优化全局簇中心以强制执行绝对的流形密度。第二阶段以这个预先结构的流形为条件，训练一个掩码自回归流（MAF）来学习精确的密度估计。我们在严格的CIC-IDS-2017基准上评估了该方法，将其视为复杂、非平稳数据流的代理。实证结果表明，明确的流形雕塑是稳健零样本泛化的先决条件。虽然监督基线在未见分布偏移上遭受了灾难性的性能崩溃（F1约0.30），而最强的无监督基线仅达到0.76，但我们的框架在严格的零样本异常上实现了0.87的F1分数。值得注意的是，我们在“渗透”场景（一种复杂的分布偏移，最先进的监督模型准确率为0.00%）中报告了88.89%的检测率。这些发现表明，将结构学习与密度估计解耦为可扩展的通用异常检测提供了一条途径。
AI.summary: 为解决高维表格数据中深度学习模型在面对分布外（OOD）数据时的泛化崩溃问题，本文提出了“潜空间雕塑”框架。该框架通过一个两阶段过程，利用双中心紧凑性损失（DCCL）将良性数据塑造成紧凑的流形结构，随后使用掩码自回归流（MAF）进行精确密度估计，从而实现了稳健的零样本异常检测。
AI.keywords: 零样本泛化, 异常检测, 流形学习, 潜空间, 双中心紧凑性损失
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于提出了一种分层两阶段框架，特别是引入了“双中心紧凑性损失”（DCCL）来主动将良性数据塑造成一个低熵、超球形的簇，从而解决高维表格数据中潜空间拓扑约束不足的问题。其重要性在于首次证明了显式的流形雕塑是实现鲁棒零样本泛化的先决条件，并在复杂的OOD检测任务上显著超越了基线方法。局限性在于仅在CIC-IDS-2017基准上进行了评估。

title: iOS as Acceleration
comments: 7 pages main text, 7 pages appendix. Presented at NeurIPS 2025 Efficient Reasoning Workshop
summary: Practical utilization of large-scale machine learning requires a powerful compute setup, a necessity which poses a significant barrier to engagement with such artificial intelligence in more restricted system environments. While cloud computing offers a solution to weaker local environments, certain situations like training involving private or sensitive data, physical environments not available through the cloud, or higher anticipated usage costs, necessitate computing locally. We explore the potential to improve weaker local compute systems at zero additional cost by taking advantage of ubiquitous yet underutilized resources: mobile phones. Specifically, recent iOS phones are equipped with surprisingly powerful processors, but they also face limitations like memory constraints, thermal throttling, and OS sandboxing. We present a proof-of-concept system demonstrating a novel approach to harness an iOS device via distributed pipeline parallelism, achieving significant benefits in a lesser compute environment by accelerating modest model training, batch inference, and agentic LRM tool-usage. We discuss practical use-cases, limitations, and directions for future work. The findings of this paper highlight the potential for the improving commonplace mobile devices to provide greater contributions to machine learning.
comment: 7 pages main text, 7 pages appendix. Presented at NeurIPS 2025 Efficient Reasoning Workshop

AI.tldr: 该研究提出利用 iPhone 等 iOS 设备强大的内置处理器来加速机器学习任务，以克服本地计算资源的限制，特别适用于处理私有数据或在云不可用的情况下。通过分布式流水线并行的方法，该系统能够加速模型训练、批量推理和代理 LRM 工具使用，为机器学习的普及提供了新的思路。
AI.motivation: 本地计算资源受限，难以进行大规模机器学习；云服务在处理私有数据、物理环境限制或成本方面存在不足；需要一种低成本的解决方案来增强本地计算能力。
AI.method: 提出利用分布式流水线并行的方法，通过网络连接 iOS 设备，将其作为分布式计算的一部分，以加速机器学习任务。
AI.result: 成功展示了一个概念验证系统，证明了利用 iOS 设备可以显著加速适度的模型训练、批量推理和代理 LRM 工具使用，尤其是在计算能力较弱的环境中。
AI.conclusion: iOS 设备拥有强大的处理器，具有作为分布式计算节点的潜力，可以显著提升机器学习任务的性能，尤其是在本地计算资源有限的情况下。未来的工作应关注克服内存限制、散热和操作系统沙盒等挑战。
AI.translation: 大规模机器学习的实际应用需要强大的计算设置，这在更受限的系统环境中成为参与此类人工智能的重大障碍。虽然云计算为较弱的本地环境提供了解决方案，但某些情况，例如涉及私有或敏感数据的训练、云无法提供的物理环境或预期的高使用成本，使得在本地进行计算成为必要。我们正在探索利用无处不在但未被充分利用的资源来改善较弱的本地计算系统，而无需额外成本：手机。特别是，最近的 iOS 手机配备了非常强大的处理器，但它们也面临内存限制、热节流和操作系统沙盒等限制。我们提出了一个概念验证系统，演示了一种通过分布式流水线并行来利用 iOS 设备的创新方法，通过加速适度的模型训练、批量推理和代理 LRM 工具使用，在计算能力较弱的环境中取得显著效益。我们讨论了实际用例、局限性和未来工作方向。该论文的研究结果凸显了改进普通移动设备为机器学习做出更大贡献的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用 iOS 设备（如 iPhone）的强大处理器来加速机器学习任务的方法，以解决本地计算资源不足的问题。研究人员开发了一个概念验证系统，利用分布式流水线并行技术，通过网络连接 iOS 设备，将其作为分布式计算的一部分，用于加速模型训练、批量推理和代理 LRM 工具使用。该方法旨在为本地计算能力较弱的环境提供一种零成本的解决方案，尤其适用于处理私有数据或云服务不可用的场景。研究讨论了实际应用、局限性以及未来研究方向，强调了普通移动设备在机器学习领域日益增长的潜力。
AI.keywords: iOS, 机器学习, 分布式计算, 流水线并行, 移动设备
AI.comments: 该研究具有创新性，巧妙地利用了移动设备这一普遍存在的资源来解决机器学习的计算瓶颈问题。其零成本的解决方案和对分布式流水线并行的探索具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，研究也指出了内存限制、散热和操作系统沙盒等实际挑战，这些是未来需要重点关注和解决的问题。

title: Interpretable Link Prediction in AI-Driven Cancer Research: Uncovering Co-Authorship Patterns
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming cancer diagnosis and treatment. The intricate nature of this disease necessitates the collaboration of diverse stakeholders with varied expertise to ensure the effectiveness of cancer research. Despite its importance, forming effective interdisciplinary research teams remains challenging. Understanding and predicting collaboration patterns can help researchers, organizations, and policymakers optimize resources and foster impactful research. We examined co-authorship networks as a proxy for collaboration within AI-driven cancer research. Using 7,738 publications (2000-2017) from Scopus, we constructed 36 overlapping co-authorship networks representing new, persistent, and discontinued collaborations. We engineered both attribute-based and structure-based features and built four machine learning classifiers. Model interpretability was performed using Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP). Random forest achieved the highest recall for all three types of examined collaborations. The discipline similarity score emerged as a crucial factor, positively affecting new and persistent patterns while negatively impacting discontinued collaborations. Additionally, high productivity and seniority were positively associated with discontinued links. Our findings can guide the formation of effective research teams, enhance interdisciplinary cooperation, and inform strategic policy decisions.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能驱动的癌症研究中可解释的链接预测：揭示共同作者模式
AI.tldr: 研究人员分析了2000年至2017年AI癌症研究的共同作者网络，使用机器学习和SHAP解释器来预测合作的形成、持续和终止。随机森林模型表现最好，发现学科相似性是关键驱动力，而高生产力和资历可能导致合作终止。这些发现有助于优化研究团队的战略组建。
AI.motivation: 癌症研究的复杂性需要不同专业知识的利益相关者协作，但组建有效的跨学科研究团队仍然具有挑战性。理解和预测合作模式有助于优化资源和促进有影响力的研究。
AI.method: 使用7,738篇出版物（2000-2017年）构建了代表新成立、持续和终止合作的36个重叠的共同作者网络。设计了基于属性和基于结构特征，并构建了四种机器学习分类器。使用Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) 进行模型可解释性分析。
AI.result: 随机森林（Random forest）在所有三种类型的考察合作中都实现了最高的召回率。学科相似性得分是关键因素，对新成立和持续的合作模式有积极影响，但对终止的合作有负面影响。此外，高生产力和资历与终止的链接呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可以指导有效研究团队的组建，增强跨学科合作，并为战略政策决策提供信息。
AI.translation: 人工智能正在改变癌症的诊断和治疗。这种疾病的复杂性质要求具有不同专业知识的各种利益相关者进行协作，以确保癌症研究的有效性。尽管如此重要，组建有效的跨学科研究团队仍然具有挑战性。理解和预测合作模式可以帮助研究人员、组织和政策制定者优化资源并促进有影响力的研究。我们考察了共同作者网络作为人工智能驱动的癌症研究中合作的代理。使用来自Scopus的7,738篇出版物（2000-2017年），我们构建了代表新成立、持续和终止合作的36个重叠的共同作者网络。我们设计了基于属性和基于结构的功能，并建立了四种机器学习分类器。使用Shapley加性解释（SHAP）进行模型可解释性分析。随机森林在所有三种考察的合作中都实现了最高的召回率。学科相似性得分是一个关键因素，对新成立和持续的模式产生积极影响，同时对终止的合作产生负面影响。此外，高生产力和资历与终止的链接呈正相关。我们的发现可以指导有效研究团队的组建，加强跨学科合作，并为战略政策决策提供信息。
AI.summary: 本研究通过分析AI驱动的癌症研究中的共同作者网络，以代理合作模式，旨在提高对跨学科研究团队组建的理解和预测能力。研究人员构建了基于属性和结构特征的模型，并使用SHAP进行可解释性分析。结果显示随机森林表现最佳，学科相似性是影响合作持续性的关键因素。
AI.keywords: AI驱动的癌症研究, 合作预测, 共同作者网络, 模型可解释性, SHAP
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将可解释性AI方法（SHAP）应用于复杂的学术合作网络分析中，以揭示影响癌症研究合作（特别是跨学科合作）的关键驱动因素。其重要性在于为优化研究团队组建和资源分配提供了实证指导。局限性在于仅使用2000年至2017年的Scopus数据，可能无法完全反映最新的合作趋势。

title: Enhancing Medical Data Analysis through AI-Enhanced Locally Linear Embedding: Applications in Medical Point Location and Imagery
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted and published at 2024 19th International Conference on Emerging Technologies (ICET)
summary: The rapid evolution of Artificial intelligence in healthcare has opened avenues for enhancing various processes, including medical billing and transcription. This paper introduces an innovative approach by integrating AI with Locally Linear Embedding (LLE) to revolutionize the handling of high-dimensional medical data. This AI-enhanced LLE model is specifically tailored to improve the accuracy and efficiency of medical billing systems and transcription services. By automating these processes, the model aims to reduce human error and streamline operations, thereby facilitating faster and more accurate patient care documentation and financial transactions. This paper provides a comprehensive mathematical model of AI-enhanced LLE, demonstrating its application in real-world healthcare scenarios through a series of experiments. The results indicate a significant improvement in data processing accuracy and operational efficiency. This study not only underscores the potential of AI-enhanced LLE in medical data analysis but also sets a foundation for future research into broader healthcare applications.

AI.title_translation: 通过人工智能增强的局部线性嵌入增强医学数据分析：在医疗点定位和成像中的应用
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合人工智能和局部线性嵌入（LLE）的方法，以提高高维医疗数据的处理能力，并应用于医疗计费和转录，结果显示准确性和效率得到显著提升。
AI.motivation: 人工智能在医疗领域的快速发展促使人们寻求更优化的数据处理方法，以提高医疗计费和转录的准确性和效率。
AI.method: 提出并构建了一个人工智能增强的局部线性嵌入（LLE）模型，并进行了数学建模，然后在医疗点定位和成像等实际医疗场景中进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该人工智能增强的LLE模型在数据处理准确性和操作效率方面取得了显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能增强的LLE在医疗数据分析方面具有巨大潜力，并为未来更广泛的医疗应用研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 人工智能在医疗保健领域的快速发展为包括医疗计费和转录在内的各种流程的改进开辟了道路。本文通过将人工智能与局部线性嵌入（LLE）相结合，提出了一种创新方法，以彻底改变高维医疗数据的处理方式。这种人工智能增强的LLE模型专门用于提高医疗计费系统和转录服务的准确性和效率。通过自动化这些流程，该模型旨在减少人为错误并简化运营，从而促进更快、更准确的患者护理文档和财务交易。本文提供了人工智能增强的LLE的综合数学模型，并通过一系列实验证明了其在现实医疗保健场景中的应用。结果表明，数据处理准确性和运营效率得到了显著改善。本研究不仅强调了人工智能增强的LLE在医疗数据分析中的潜力，而且为未来更广泛的医疗应用研究奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究引入了一种结合人工智能和局部线性嵌入（LLE）的新方法，旨在解决高维医疗数据处理的挑战。该模型特别关注于提高医疗计费和转录服务的准确性和效率，通过自动化流程来减少错误并优化运营。通过数学建模和实际医疗场景的实验验证，研究证明了该方法在提升数据处理精度和运营效率方面的有效性，并为未来在医疗领域的进一步应用提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 局部线性嵌入, 医疗数据分析, 医疗计费, 效率提升
AI.comments: 该研究在将AI与LLE相结合以处理高维医疗数据方面具有创新性，特别是在医疗计费和转录领域的应用。然而，摘要中未提供关于具体AI技术或LLE改进细节的信息，也未详细说明实验的具体设置和规模，这限制了对其影响力和局限性的全面评估。未来的研究可以更深入地探讨模型的具体实现和与其他现有方法的比较。

title: Unbiased Visual Reasoning with Controlled Visual Inputs
summary: End-to-end Vision-language Models (VLMs) often answer visual questions by exploiting spurious correlations instead of causal visual evidence, and can become more shortcut-prone when fine-tuned. We introduce VISTA (Visual-Information Separation for Text-based Analysis), a modular framework that decouples perception from reasoning via an explicit information bottleneck. A frozen VLM sensor is restricted to short, objective perception queries, while a text-only LLM reasoner decomposes each question, plans queries, and aggregates visual facts in natural language. This controlled interface defines a reward-aligned environment for training unbiased visual reasoning with reinforcement learning. Instantiated with Qwen2.5-VL and Llama3.2-Vision sensors, and trained with GRPO from only 641 curated multi-step questions, VISTA significantly improves robustness to real-world spurious correlations on SpuriVerse (+16.29% with Qwen-2.5-VL-7B and +6.77% with Llama-3.2-Vision-11B), while remaining competitive on MMVP and a balanced SeedBench subset. VISTA transfers robustly across unseen VLM sensors and is able to recognize and recover from VLM perception failures. Human analysis further shows that VISTA's reasoning traces are more neutral, less reliant on spurious attributes, and more explicitly grounded in visual evidence than end-to-end VLM baselines.

title: SAMM2D: Scale-Aware Multi-Modal 2D Dual-Encoder for High-Sensitivity Intracrania Aneurysm Screening
